question: The One Health framework recognises that human, animal, and environmental health are interconnected, and that most emerging infectious diseases have a zoonotic origin.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Reconsider — One Health explicitly links all three domains. COVID-19, Nipah, and mpox all illustrate zoonotic spillover into humans, which is the core rationale for One Health surveillance.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Exactly right. WHO, FAO, and UNEP jointly advocate One Health; over 60% of emerging infections are zoonotic, making cross-sectoral collaboration essential for outbreak prevention.
